notes: Measured on AE 2026 8 bpc. Popup 1..10 per output channel (AE 1 alpha, 2 red, 3 green, 4 blue): 1 Alpha, 2 Red, 3 Green, 4 Blue, 5 Luminance, 6 Hue, 7 Lightness, 8 Saturation, 9 Full, 10 Off (order 1..5 measured; 6..10 assumed from AE's menu, its max is 10). Sources are read from the STRAIGHT 8-bit pixel (transparent pixels = black), the new straight colour is premultiplied by the new alpha ((c8 * a8 + 127) div 255). Channel swaps bit-exact; Luminance = round(255 * (0.299 R + 0.587 G + 0.114 B)) (Rec.601, rounded; 0.30/0.59/0.11 or flooring is worse) bit-exact where the straight colour is recoverable. The only offline residual (1/255 on the 5373 pixels of the 50 % alpha circle) is an input limitation: its straight colour (0,200,255) is premultiplied to (0,100,128) before the shader sees it and un-premultiplies to 199, so 199*146/255 -> 114 vs AE's 115 (AE has the straight footage). Hue / Lightness / Saturation = standard HLS components x 255 rounded (hue 0 = red, greys hue 0), Full = 255, Off = 0: not covered by a visible ref. AE 5 Compositing Options not reproduced. Rive residuals (max 1-2/255, mean <= 0.008 %) are the Rive canvas/composite +-1 noise already documented on tint/invert, not the shader.
